overview.text: Today's key developments highlight progress across agentic self-improvement, multimodal architectures, and local deployment options. Researchers introduced capability-driven recursive self-improvement frameworks for multimodal agents alongside studies exploring human feedback loops in autonomous post-training. In interactive media and generation, new paradigms emerged for free-form interactive world generation and unified local video stylization. Meanwhile, the open release ecosystem expanded with specialized models like LiquidAI/LFM3-1.7B and OvisOCR3, offering new capabilities for local applications and document parsing tasks. In infrastructure, optimization techniques for Mixture of Experts inference on NVIDIA hardware advanced throughput for large deployments. Finally, enterprise adoption continued to grow as partnerships brought Claude to government agencies, signaling broader deployment integration.

entries.title: The Trinity:Capability-Driven Recursive Self-Improvement for Multimodal Agents
entries.summary: Multimodal intelligence can be viewed as human-guided co-evolution between worlds and agents through interaction.
entries.why: Advances multimodal agent capabilities through capability-driven recursive self-improvement and human-guided co-evolution.

entries.title: Hy-Nomas: Towards Free-form Interactive World Generation
entries.summary: Interactive world generation requires models to follow successive commands while preserving relevant history and action consequences.
entries.why: Enables interactive world generation by following successive commands while preserving relevant history.

entries.title: LociArt: A Unified Paradigm for Free-Style Local Video Stylization
entries.summary: Video stylization typically transforms entire scenes, while local artistic editing requires precise region--style association, spatial control, and temporal consistency.
entries.why: Provides precise region-style association and temporal consistency for free-style local video stylization.

entries.title: Expanding our partnership with GSA to bring Claude to all levels of government
entries.summary: Anthropic is an AI safety and research company that's working to build reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems.
entries.why: Expands Claude availability across all levels of government through a partnership with GSA.

entries.title: OvisOCR3 Technical Report
entries.summary: We introduce OvisOCR3, a 0.8B model for a broad range of OCR-related tasks. OvisOCR3 unifies document parsing, general OCR, key information extraction (KIE), document figure captioning, and cross-page table reconstruction in a single model.
entries.why: Unifies document parsing, OCR, key information extraction, and table reconstruction in a compact model.

entries.title: RSI Arena: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement with Human Feedback
entries.summary: Can AI agents autonomously train useful language models and improve them using feedback from users? We introduce RSI Arena, a two-stage study of autonomous post-training as a step toward recursive self-improvement.
entries.why: Investigates autonomous post-training and recursive self-improvement using human feedback for language models.

entries.title: Cross-modal Steering Vectors Exist Across Both Image and Text Generation
entries.summary: Are concepts and mechanisms unified across modalities in current AI models, or instead implemented separately for each one?
entries.why: Explores whether concepts and mechanisms are unified or implemented separately across image and text generation.

entries.title: LiquidAI/LFM3-1.7B · Hugging Face
entries.summary: https://huggingface.co/LiquidAI/LFM3-1.7B-GGUF from liquidAI: LFM3-1.7B is a text model for local agents and specialized applications, based on our new tri-hybrid architecture.
entries.why: Introduces a tri-hybrid architecture text model tailored for local agents and specialized applications.

entries.title: Lightricks/LTX-2.5
entries.why: Offers image-to-video capabilities with extensive community downloads and usage on Hugging Face.

entries.title: abenzerps/Qwen-Image-2.1-Uncensored-Quantized
entries.why: Provides an uncensored quantized text-to-image model variant for community experimentation and deployment.

entries.title: 3 Ways to Boost MoE Inference on NVIDIA DGX Spark
entries.summary: Optimization 1: Humming MXFP4 MoE backend Optimization 2: Online FP8 LM head quantization Optimization 3: MTP speculative decoding with NEXTN Configuration TPOT Decode throughput Relative to baseline Baseline 27.71 ms 36.09 tok/s — + Humming MoE backend 25.35 ms 39.45 tok/s…
entries.why: Optimizes Mixture of Experts inference performance on NVIDIA DGX Spark hardware configurations.

entries.title: Legora is building the agentic operating system for legal work
entries.summary: See how Legora uses OpenAI models, ChatGPT, and Codex to accelerate legal workflows, expand contract analysis, and free lawyers to focus on higher-value work.
entries.why: Accelerates legal workflows and contract analysis using OpenAI models and ChatGPT integrations.

entries.title: Anthropic Versus Anthropic
entries.why: Examines strategic and operational complexities within Anthropic as an AI safety organization.

entries.title: Notes on “We’re in Triage Mode for AI Safety” by Miles Brundage
entries.summary: This reading was previously included Day 2 of the BlueDot Governance course. In the newest version of the BlueDot Governance course, this reading is now optional.
entries.why: Discusses triage mode for AI safety in the context of recent governance course updates.

entries.title: Setting the Scene (Public v1; October 25)
entries.summary: Context: I created this to share before the start of courses I facilitate to provide a refresher on recent events, but also as a hook to draw students into engaging with some of ideas we think about and debate in AI safety early.
entries.why: Provides a refresher on recent events to draw students into AI safety debates.
